title: Notification toasts
description: The workbench's notification toast stack (`.monaco-workbench > .notifications-toasts`): pinned to the bottom-right (or bottom-left / top-right) corner, newest toast on top, at most 3 toasts (NotificationsToasts.MAX_NOTIFICATIONS). Uses the modern-UI insets from notificationsDialogs.css (--modern-ui-notifications-inline-inset / -block-end-inset, 8px / 36px by default, 32px bottom with .nostatusbar on the workbench). The Agents window sets both insets to 8px (sessions/browser/media/workbench.css); set those variables on the workbench to match. Position rules are captured for bottom-right and for bottom-left with no status bar.
usage: Place once as a direct child of <vsc-workbench> and call show({ severity, message, buttons, source }) to raise toasts. Set position="bottom-left" to match workbench.notifications.position. Add the nostatusbar class to the workbench when the window has no status bar. For the Agents window also set --modern-ui-notifications-inline-inset and --modern-ui-notifications-block-end-inset to var(--vscode-spacing-size80) on the workbench.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: Lay out in the document flow instead of pinning to a workbench corner (for docs and specimens)

examples.title: Stack
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification severity="warning" message="Session deleted." source="DT Notify" configure sticky no-animation></vsc-notification><vsc-notification severity="error" message="Build failed on darwin-arm64: @vscode/spdlog has no prebuild for Electron 39." source="DT Notify" buttons="Open Session,Retry" configure sticky no-animation></vsc-notification><vsc-notification severity="info" message="Marked as done." source="DT Notify" buttons="Undo" configure sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>
